title: Data export
intro: You can always take your data with you. Choose what to export; the file is prepared in the background and stays available for 7 days.

form.codeHint: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code. It is needed every time you request an export. For one person's data, you enter it on the confirmation step.
form.contactIdHint: For a data subject request (GDPR access or portability): the contact whose data you export. Leave empty for the other exports.

failure.TOO_LARGE: The export is too large for one file.
failure.TIMEOUT: The export took too long. Request it again.
failure.INTERNAL: The export failed. Request it again.

done: Export requested. It will be ready shortly; reload this page to follow it.

errors.MFA_CODE_INVALID: That code is not valid or was already used. Enter the current code and try again.
errors.DATA_EXPORT_IN_PROGRESS: Another export is still running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only agency admins can export data.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.load: The exports could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
errors.DATA_SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND: That contact does not exist or was erased.

confirm.title: Confirm whose data you export
confirm.body: This export holds everything the agency keeps about {name}: contact details, consents, enquiries, viewings and notes. Check that this is the person who asked before you continue.
